_doc: Import Records pasted into FileMaker Pro 26.0.3 on macOS (never run) and copied back: every XML source pairing (file, URL, calculation, variable; file path lists; a style sheet file path cut to its file name on the line), FileMaker's step-level copy of an XML calculation (XC-COPY, XC-COPYONLY; XC-XSC pasted with only <XMLCalc> loses the XML calculation, as on Convert File), the import options and Restore with an XML source, and the non-XML sources (file paths, a CSV / tab / FileMaker source Profile, a folder). `pasted` is what was pasted, `fm` FileMaker's copy-out, `fmLine` FileMaker's Script Workspace line and `fmSources` what FileMaker draws in the path slot for an XML source. FileMaker fills <TargetFields> with every field of the target table. FOLDER was pasted with guessed folder attributes FileMaker does not keep. XF-WITHUPL holds a <UniversalPathList> next to an XML source, which FileMaker keeps but does not draw. Cases marked restoreFromCompanions hold a Restore state the converter derives from the import options and table (the catalog's Restore rule): with Restore off the converter writes no import options and an empty table, and Restore on with neither is read back off, so the round-trip tests skip them; their Profile still converts. F-NOPATH (no path) gets no <UniversalPathList>; F-FMPTABLE was pasted with table="Customers" and FileMaker wrote table="0"; X-EMPTYXSL's empty <XSLFile> is dropped; X-BLANKTYPE was pasted with an XML source but DataType "    ", and FileMaker dropped XMLType, XSLType and the source.
